diagnosis: VulnerabilityDisclosureViewSet protects zero-day bug reports with IsVulnerabilityReporterOrReadOnly. Because the permission grants access to all SAFE_METHODS, any authenticated external security researcher or bug bounty participant can read unreleased zero-day vulnerability reports, proof-of-concept exploits, and reproduction scripts submitted by other researchers prior to patch deployment.
